versions.changelog:
- Major update: Skill rebranded to "polymarket-fast-loop" with advanced trading workflow and safety controls.
- Adds TradingAgents 5-layer pipeline and 50-persona swarm consensus for enhanced trade decisions.
- Integrates ACTA Ed25519 receipts for every trade (IETF draft-farley-acta-signed-receipts-03 compliant).
- Includes Cedar policy engine for pre/post trade authorization and policy governance.
- Strict safety controls: trades only when both pipeline and swarm agree, position size caps, stop-loss/take-profit, and paper-trading enforced by default.
- Expanded configuration and environment variable options for flexible deployment.
